description: Allowlist of the structural layer of scripts/gate_structured_prose.py (Phase B harness pairs, winner_summary 1.3). Authored config text may contain no numeric token, number word, lead / objective / count phrase, except where an entry below covers the token: the entry's regex must match a span that contains the token, inside an attribute path matching `paths` (fnmatch on the dotted path, e.g. StoryConfig.HERO_CAPTION, METHODOLOGY_CONFIG.methods_table_md). Every result value (Sharpe, return, drawdown, lead, count, windows, percentiles of the null) must come from a winner_fields placeholder or an artifact read at render time. Each entry states why its numbers are not results.

entries.why: Transform / window / horizon definitions of the pair spec (e.g. '60-month rolling', '3-month change', '21-day forward return'); they define signals, not results. Leads use a different phrase class (earlier / lagged / lead), which stays banned.

entries.regex: \b(?:trailing|rolling|over the last|over the trailing|its own trailing|of its own trailing|previous)\s+\d+(?:,\d{3})?\s+(?:trading days|business days|days|months|quarters|weeks|years)\b
entries.why: Rolling-window lengths of the declared thresholds and transforms (spec constants).

Threshold definitions (the declared percentile of a rolling or in-sample threshold), in the threshold dictionaries and methodology tables only; a percentile RESULT elsewhere must come from a field (QA_VERIFY_B0r).
Calendar references to historical events, publication dates and methodology-change dates. Denied in sentences about result windows (test / training / OOS), whose dates come from winner_fields.

Series ids (BAMLH0A0HYM2, DGS10, VIX3M), column / signal / threshold codes (hy_ig_roc_63d, T_roll_p75, S6, T1, P2) and strategy family names. Leads (L<n>) are not identifiers and stay banned. Methodology rule ids (R7.1) are rule names, not values.

entries.regex: \bp\s*[<=>]\s*0\.0[15]\b|\b0\.05 line\b|±?\b95% (?:bands?|interval|confidence)|square root of 4|√4|\b5 bps?\b|\b5 basis points\b|\bq\s*=\s*2\b|\b15% trimming\b|\bk\s*=\s*2\b|2-state|2-regime|\b0\.5\b(?= \((?:calm|stress))|(?:at or below|above) 0\.5\b|probability (?:threshold )?0\.5\b|\b5% critical value\b|\b95% (?:HAC )?(?:confidence )?interval\b
entries.why: Conventions of the methods (significance level, interval level, quarterly annualization, the 5 bp cost assumption, model sizes, regime probability cut-off 0.5) that do not describe the pair's result.
Plain-language descriptions of the declared signal and threshold codes; they mirror the pair spec (scripts/pair_spec_<pair>.py), not results.
Methods and data-source tables: model specifications (lags, horizons, quantiles, HAC rule) and source frequencies. Numeric tokens only; lead / objective / count phrases are still checked there.
Proper names (index, disease) and quartile labels Q1-Q4.

Position sizes of the long/cash family, only in a position phrase ('hold 100% SPY', 'exposure from 0% to 100%', 'HOLD SPY (100%)', '100% invested') and the trade log's notional stake; a bare 0% / 100% is a result and fails (QA_VERIFY_B0r).

entries.regex: \blags?\s+\d+\s*(?:-|–|to)\s*\d+|\blags? of \d+ to \d+|\btau\s*=\s*0\.\d+|\boffsets?\s+[-−]?\d+\s*(?:\.\.|to|-)\s*\+?\d+|\b\d+(?:,\s*\d+)*,?\s+and\s+\d+\s+(?:quarters|months|days|trading days)\b|\b\d+\s+(?:signal transforms|transforms|buckets|quartiles|regimes|states|signals|strategies \(|leads \{)|\{\d+(?:,\s*\d+)*\}|\b\d+-quarter delinquency change|\bat \d+(?:,\s*\d+)* and \d+ days\b|\blags?\s+[-+−]?\d+(?:\s*(?:-|–|to|and)\s*[-+−]?\d+)?|\bmax\(0\.75\s*·?\s*n\^\(1/3\),\s*h-1\)|\bh\s*-\s*1\b|\bh\s*=\s*\d+d?\b|\bevery \d+ trading days\b
entries.why: Specifications of the evidence methods and the declared grid (Granger / CCF lags, regression quantiles, horizon lists, number of transforms or buckets, the lead set as declared in the registry); they define methods, not results.

entries.regex: \b(?:two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|twelve|fifteen)\s+(?:data tracks|tracks|buckets|quartiles|signal transforms|transforms|neighbouring leads|neighbouring grid leads|adjacent leads|steps|regimes|states|legs|channels|pages|tiers|signals|methods|tests|strategies|threshold schemes|equal-count quartiles|quartile means|regime probabilities|lags)\b|\b(?:one|two)\s+(?:track|data views?|views?|series|directions?|legs?)\b
entries.why: Counts of page / method structure (pages, tracks, quartile buckets, transforms in the declared grid, the D9 window of three leads), not result counts.

entries.regex: \babout one business day after (?:the|its) (?:value )?date\b|\bone[- ](?:trading[- ])?day execution lag\b|\ba further execution day\b|\bat least one (?:trading )?day back\b|\beffective lag is at least two trading days\b|\bshortest lead in the traded grid is one trading day\b
entries.why: The publication rule and execution lag recorded in the lead-axis registry (release_calendar_series rule:next_business_day, position_shift 1, lead_floor_effective 2); not results.
Sizes of the declared candidate manifest (number of signals, threshold labels, strategies) in the design table header cells; candidates_manifest_<tag>.json records them.

The declared candidate-manifest table (signals, threshold labels and their parameters, strategies, lead grid, validity constants); it is the pre-declared search space of candidates_manifest_<tag>.json, not a result. Lead / objective / count phrases are still checked.
FRB definition of the delinquency series DRCCLACBN (balances 30 or more days past due); a fixed series definition, not a result.
